description: This file defines a set of asynchronous command functions for a survey-related router in a web API. It registers multiple survey endpoints, each mapped to a specific survey query, using the 'router.command' decorator. The functions construct and return query objects based on provided parameters.

methods.name: OBBject bls_series( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches time series data for BLS series IDs based on provided parameters.

methods.name: OBBject bls_search( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Searches BLS surveys by category and keywords.

methods.name: OBBject sloos( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves the Senior Loan Officers Opinion Survey.

methods.name: OBBject university_of_michigan( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Obtains the University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment and Inflation Expectations surveys.

methods.name: OBBject economic_conditions_chicago( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches details about the Chicago region's economic conditions survey.

methods.name: OBBject manufacturing_outlook_texas( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturing outlook survey data for Texas.

methods.name: OBBject manufacturing_outlook_ny( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves the Empire State Manufacturing Survey data for New York.

methods.name: OBBject nonfarm_payrolls( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Gets data from the Nonfarm Payrolls Survey.
